environments.name: Deep-space transit (Mars cruise-like)
environments.description: Unprotected interplanetary transit during solar minimum; primary GCR flux.
environments.source: Zeitlin et al. (2013) Science 340, 1080 (MSL RAD cruise measurements)
environments.traversal_note: A given cell nucleus is traversed by a proton every few days and by an HZE ion every few months.

environments.name: Mars-like surface
environments.description: Planetary body shadow blocks 2pi steradians; thin CO2 column provides minimal shielding.
environments.source: Hassler et al. (2014) Science 343 (MSL RAD surface measurements)
environments.traversal_note: Secondary albedo neutrons generated in regolith contribute ~15% of surface dose equivalent.

environments.name: Low Earth orbit (ISS-like)
environments.description: Altitude ~400 km, 51.6° inclination; protected by Earth's geomagnetic dipole field.
environments.source: UNSCEAR (2008) / NASA Human Research Program Dosimetry records
environments.traversal_note: Passes through South Atlantic Anomaly (SAA) trapped proton belt several times daily.

environments.name: Large solar particle event (hypothetical peak)
environments.description: Coronal mass ejection proton shock front arriving at 1 AU; intense acute flux.
environments.source: King (1974) / August 1972 SPE proxy (unshielded interplanetary model)
environments.traversal_note: Immediate storm shelter required to prevent acute radiation syndrome (ARS) prodrome.

shielding.name: No Shielding (Unshielded free space)
shielding.notes: Direct incident flux with zero structural attenuation.

shielding.name: Light Shielding (~2 g/cm² aluminum / EVA suit)
shielding.notes: Stops soft solar protons; negligible reduction for high-energy galactic cosmic rays.

shielding.name: Moderate Shielding (~15 g/cm² storm shelter / regolith)
shielding.notes: Substantial attenuation of solar particle events; secondary neutron scatter produced.

shielding.name: Heavy Shielding (~45 g/cm² water-wall / lava tube)
shielding.notes: Hydrogen-rich material absorbing primary ions; heavy structural mass overhead.
